on Thursday that it intends to offer $500M of senior notes due in 2034 in a private offering.
The company expects to use the net proceeds, along with $1.1B of incremental senior secured term loans, to fund the proposed acquisition of Epiq Solutions.
The proceeds may also be used for general corporate purposes, including reducing borrowings related to the proposed acquisition of Swiss Technology Group.

The notes will be subject to mandatory redemption at 100% of principal plus accrued and unpaid interest if the Epiq Solutions acquisition is not completed by Nov. 15, 2026, subject to certain extensions.

title: TTM Technologies announces proposed $500M senior notes offering
